title: Finally a Clash! Jounin VS. Genin!! Indiscriminate Grand Melee Tournament!!
overview: An event has come to Konoha and it's for all ninjas, Jounin to Genin. The winner get to make one rule that will be put into play in Konoha and Suna. But you must have your crystal at the end. Naruto wants to fight Kakashi-sensei but will he ever find him? And when he does will he get Kakashi's crystal? Who will win?
